name: Star's Lover "ReaKoi" Datte, Ii Janai!
original_name: Star’s Lover “リア恋” だって、いいじゃない!
source:
The heroine, Airi Hanasaka, is just an ordinary college student. She’s a huge fan of the idol group HEARTiS! She gets to date one of the members after he asks her out…! Having such a popular guy all to herself is nice, but dating an idol has its cons too. Between the ups and downs, where will their relationship go?

[Edited from [url=https://sinfulliesel.com/2019/07/01/stars-lover-real-koi-datte-ii-janai/]Sinful Liesel[/url]]
translation:
女主角花坂爱莉是普通大学生，也是偶像团体HEARTiS的超级粉丝！其中一名成员向她告白后，她与他开始交往……！独占这样一位人气偶像固然很好，但与偶像约会也有缺点。在经历高低起伏后，他们的关系将走向何方？
